items.title: SpaceX Starship returns to landing pad from orbit, acing test for reusable rockets
items.summary: The spacecraft completed a 22-hour orbital flight before being caught by mechanical arms at its Texas launch tower, marking a major step towards SpaceX’s goal of developing fully reusable rockets.

items.title: Three dead, two injured in Mugu jeep crash
items.summary: The jeep plunged about 600 metres off the road in Chhayanath Rara Municipality while travelling from Surkhet to Rara.

items.title: Nepal sets up accreditation centre to ease testing and certification
items.summary: The agency aims to reduce testing costs, strengthen quality assurance and help Nepali products gain international recognition, but exporters say it could take up to three years to secure global accreditation.

items.title: Bhurtel falls one run short as Pokhara post record NPL total
items.summary: Kushal Bhurtel hits 99 off 51 balls as Pokhara Avengers pile up 224 for three against Kathmandu Gorkhas, the highest total in the competition’s history.

items.title: Changing farming practices threaten food and habitats of migratory birds
items.summary: The expansion of winter crops, shrinking wetlands, and rising use of pesticide are putting the survival of thousands of birds arriving in Nepal from Tibet, Mongolia, and Siberia at risk.

items.title: India approves weekly train service linking Janakpur and Ayodhya
items.summary: The 604-km cross-border service will connect two major Ramayana pilgrimage destinations, with stops in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh. The launch date and fares are yet to be announced.

items.title: Karnali sign off with consolation win as Chitwan finish fourth
items.summary: The Rhinos, already through to the playoffs, end the league stage on seven points after falling 24 runs short of a 154-run target.

items.title: Tinkar villagers face seven-hour walk for medical care
items.summary: With no health post in the border village, residents must take the sick across the border into India or walk seven hours to the nearest health facility. A community health centre built four years ago remains unused.

items.title: Top scorer on South Korean tax exam confesses to cheating with AI
items.summary: Han says he used a microcamera to photograph exam questions and an AI tool to find the answers, raising fresh concerns about cheating ahead of Thursday’s national college entrance exam.

items.title: Bhattarai urges Prime Minister Shah to put five issues on agenda for India visit
items.summary: In an interview with Kantipur, the former prime minister says Nepal should press India on the border dispute, trade deficit, air routes and hydropower, while seeking trilateral cooperation on the Himalayan climate crisis.

items.title: Hydropower firms to need 50 percent construction progress for IPOs
items.summary: The proposed ordinance would allow companies to issue shares before commercial production begins, provided their projects have completed at least half of the physical work.

items.title: Karnali set Chitwan a target of 154 in final league match
items.summary: Hasan Talat hits an unbeaten half-century as Karnali Yakss, already out of playoff contention, post 153-8; Chitwan have secured a playoff berth.

items.title: Dhaulagiri Hospital still waiting for trauma centre a decade after announcement
items.summary: The Hari Khadka Trauma Centre, announced in 2015, remains short of buildings, staff and infrastructure despite the availability of equipment and some specialist doctors.

items.title: US air travel disruptions to persist until late on Sunday, FAA head says
items.summary: Federal Aviation Administration head Bryan Bedford said on Saturday that he expected airline operations to largely ​return to normal by late Sunday.

items.title: Bahrain issues first threat alerts since September as Iran says it attacked US base
items.summary: The Revolutionary Guards said they had launched ​six drones targeting a US air-defence radar at the Al-Rifaa helicopter ⁠base in Bahrain.

items.title: India’s Nitin Gadkari to attend Nepal Infrastructure Summit as keynote speaker
items.summary: The December 9–10 summit will bring together policymakers, investors and development partners to discuss infrastructure financing, regional connectivity and climate-resilient projects.

items.title: Jayanti Memorial Trust marks 25 years of expanding access to heart care
items.summary: Trust has supported more than 10,000 heart surgeries, organised cardiac health camps in 53 districts and provided heart health education to over 6,000 students.

items.title: Oil Corporation brings Rs300 billion in annual transactions under digital system
items.summary: More than 1,500 dealers, 60 bottlers and 60 airlines will be able to place fuel orders and make payments online through the new ERP system.

items.title: UK’s Prince William to be joined by wife Kate for visit to India
items.summary: Heir-to-the-throne William, 44, and Kate are flying out for a series of events across Mumbai during a three-day visit that includes Tuesday’s awards ceremony.

items.title: Nākaloka makes Kathmandu debut with an evening of music, devotion and silence
items.summary: The movement brought together spiritual traditions, music and meditative practices in an evening of collective reflection at Basantapur.
